review.notes: Inspected all 35 after-page renderings, compared against before renderings, pages.json, and plan.json. Planned redactions removed the title-page author/affiliation/contact block, venue headers, arXiv sidebar, OpenReview manuscript link, GitHub/code footnote, and acknowledgments/funding text. Candidate PDF text, metadata, annotations, and binary strings did not contain the removed identifiers. Redacted areas render as whitespace without clipping surrounding scientific content; ordinary citations/references remain preserved.

token_usage.accounting_note: Input totals include cached input; output totals include reasoning output. These subsets are not added again. Totals cover reported usage only; attempts without usage may still have consumed tokens.
